Title / Description: Login to eSuite with valid credentials
Precondition:
- eSuite is reachable.
- The browser is on the eSuite login page.
- Valid QA credentials from the assignment brief are available.
Test Steps:
1. Open https://esuite.edot.id.
2. Click Use Email or Username.
3. Enter the valid QA email from the assignment brief.
4. Submit the email.
5. Enter the matching QA password.
6. Submit the password.
7. Wait for the eDOT Account Center redirect to complete.
8. Observe the eSuite dashboard.
Test Data (exact values):
URL: https://esuite.edot.id
Email: Valid QA email supplied in the assignment brief
Password: Matching QA password supplied in the assignment brief
Expected Result:
- Authentication succeeds.
- The user is redirected back to eSuite.
- The dashboard is displayed.
- The text "Welcome Back," is visible.

- Location and camera permissions are allowed.
- No customer named Toko Sentosa Manual QA exists.
- The device has a stable network connection.

1. Open New Customer. Scroll only if the menu is not visible.
2. Tap New Customer Registration.
3. Enter Outlet Name.
4. Enter Contact.
5. Enter Contact Person.
6. Select Channel and Customer Type.
7. Continue to Locations.
8. Select Address Type.
9. Tap Use my current location.
10. Verify Address is populated. Record the full value.
11. Select Province.
12. Select City.
13. Select District.
14. Select Sub District.
15. Verify Postal Code is populated. If blank, select 11530.
16. Continue to Documents.
17. Enter the 16-digit KTP number.

19. Confirm the captured image.
20. Submit the document.
21. Draw one continuous signature stroke.
22. Tap Register or Save and confirm the registration.
23. Verify the success message and continue to New Customer List.
24. Check for the customer card in the current viewport.
25. If absent, fast-scroll to the bottom and check again.
